published.citation: González-Santamaría et al. (2021), A&A 656, A51, Table 8: log(Teff) = 5.05, a temperature from the literature the paper compiles; spectral type hgO(H): 112200 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.12114

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 175353 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
